notes.title: Fly Cowboy Online. Announcement #21
Hello, cowboys! Here’s our Announcement #20
notes.content:
[p][b]**1. Oblivion Valley Tutorial Map (Level 0-14)**[/b]
[/p][p]>In this announcement, we'll fly all the Gears and demonstrate encounters with various mobs and show you how some skills work.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]**2. Q&A (bugfix list)**[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]>M-Gear Skills[/b][/p][p]> At the moment, we've finished balancing some skills, but haven't delved into working on group skills, as this is outside the scope of the current testing schedule. We plan to do this when we start the fixing of group interactions.[/p][p] [/p][p]>SP recovery while using Focus Recovery[/p][p]> Health and shield are now always correctly displayed on the HUD panel.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]>Rocket flight and target acquisition[/b][/p][p]> Significant changes have been made to target acquisition and detection. Target’s distance and damage display both work correctly. However, in the future, these parameters will most likely be changed.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]>Inventory and item management[/b][/p][p]> At the moment, the inventory only works for moving skills. In the future, we will develop a convenient tab system so that you can access all of Gear's gameplay features with just one button.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]>Collisions and explosions[/b][/p][p]> Today, we are ready to demonstrate a new, more advanced collision system for both player and mobs, rocks, map edge, etc.). We have also added an intelligent grid along the edges of the map that will not allow players to go beyond the map and use some bugs.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]>Moving skills from the panel after activation[/b][/p][p]> During the broadcast, there were cases where players abused skills by moving them to the inventory and back. We are looking for a solution to this problem.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]>Review after death[/b][/p][p]> To prevent players from taking advantage of the death camera, we disabled this feature[/p][p] [/p][p]>Enemy detection at a distance[/p][p]> Work was carried out on all 10 points of comments regarding radars, notification distances, etc. Now you will always understand where they are shooting at you from, who is shooting, and at what distance.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]>Invisibility for B-Gear[/b][/p][p]> In the latest build, this skill completely stopped working. We corrected a couple of parameters, but new difficulties arose. Now, depending on some events, invisibility does not turn on. Work continues.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]>Auto-horizon[/b][/p][p]> We returned to this issue again and are testing different conditions under which it will work correctly, but this turned out to be a bigger problem than it seemed, there’s a lot of work to do.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]>Connecting to the server and synchronization[/b][/p][p]> We are actively working on finding a new server in Europe and have already settled on several options. The alpha test will have a better connection for most players. There will be 3 game servers in early access:[/p][p]>Europe+CIS;[/p][p]>Asia;[/p][p]>America.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]>Other fixes[/b][/p][p]> "Charge Shot" animation was replaced with a brighter one and some features has been to ability’s range;[/p][p]> Fixes has been added to radar and sound effects for player’s HP level changing;[/p][p]> Engine adjustments, especially with sharp increases and decreases in speed;[/p][p]> Target acquisition and roll are still being balanced, so now events trigger work correctly in most cases.[/p][p] [/p][p]> B-Gear missile explosion radius is in the process of adjustment, but even now you can inflict decent damage with due skill.[/p][p] [/p][p]> Explosions have been completely reworked and are now not as cartoonish as they were before. We will strive for a more realistic visual style, but with medium saturation.[/p][p] [/p][p]> Machine gun traces are now visible at a greater distance, but we are still adjusting this aspect and hit sound effects.[/p][p] [/p][p]> The camera can now zoom in all directions to up to 400%.[/p][p] [/p][p]> Hard on targeting system continues. We are aware of all current issues.[/p][p] [/p][p]> Now can be targeted by unlimited amount of enemies. You will see the corresponding notifications and incoming damage vectors.[/p][p] [/p][p]> And about 30 more minor improvements![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]**Looking for YouTube Creators**[/b][/h3][p]>We’re ready to provide [b]free game keys[/b] to YouTubers with an audience of [b]10,000+ subscribers[/b]. For details, reach out to [b]Lana Miao[/b] on Discord or via a support ticket.
 >We’re also looking for project ambassadors worldwide and are open to partnership discussions. Contact [b]Lana Miao[/b] in Discord or via ticket for all the details.[/p][h3][b]**4. Additional Info**[/b][/h3][p]>Announcement #21 is scheduled for [b]September 1, 2025[/b].

Full Video: [url="https://youtu.be/8THXz27WZRY"]https://youtu.be/8THXz27WZRY[/url]  (available now)


[/p]
